page.layout: Running head centred at top; page number at top left. One column of consul lists, ruled into groups, with the year at the right of each group. Marginal notes in the left margin, in italics. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.l: Fœdus civitatis Groning. cū Drensinis.Eno Wigboldi.
Gerhar. Sicking. Joh. Folkardius. Lubbertus Goes. Al-bertus Iuvenis. hi. iv. Rationales vocantur in quodam in-strumento antiquo, hoc anno confecto.Henricus Pluckerose.
Bellum ad Vul-lenhoam inter Frisios, & episcop. Vlrajectt[?].Richardus Renoldi. | 1312

page.notes: The year L311 is unclear; it may be a corrupted 1311 and is marked [?]. The note "Vlrajectt" (Ultrajectt) is doubtful, and the "Vul-lenhoam" hyphenation is as printed. "(ding." is the end of "Folkerding" continued across the line; the opening parenthesis is doubtful. The 1314 entry has no names printed. The bullet after "270" is an ornament and is not transcribed. The catchword "Berwol-" is at the foot of the column. The "Fasti" in the running head is printed with a long s, transcribed as plain s.
